blocks.text: Optimize your workflow for real estate presentations

Real estate analysts spend too much time on formatting. You want to focus on the numbers, not the alignment of text boxes. To work faster, keep your most used tools on the Quick Access Toolbar. Go to View > Ribbon and Toolbar > Customize the Ribbon. Add your favorite tools like Align Center or Bring to Front.

Keyboard shortcuts are your best friend on a Mac. Replace the Windows Ctrl key with the Command ⌘ key. Use ⌘ + Shift + N to insert a new slide. Use ⌘ + Option + G to group objects together. This saves you from dragging your mouse across the screen to select multiple items.
Managing data and imagery in PowerPoint

When you bring in site photos or maps, they can bloat your file size. Right click on an image and select Compress Pictures. This keeps your file size low, which is helpful when emailing large pitch decks to clients. If your images are blurry, ensure you are not scaling them beyond their native resolution.

blocks.text: Analysts often clutter slides with too much data. A slide should have one clear takeaway. If you need to show a large table, put the summary on the slide and the full data in the appendix. Avoid using small fonts that are hard to read on a projector. Keep text at 18 points or larger.

Another common mistake is inconsistent styling. Use the Format Painter tool. Select an object with the style you like, press ⌘ + Shift + C to copy the style, and ⌘ + Shift + V to paste it onto another object. This ensures your headings and bullet points look identical throughout the presentation.

Lazur helps you navigate the interface when you are in a rush. If you cannot find a specific setting, hold ⌥ ⌘ and ask where it is. Lazur will draw a circle around the button on your screen. You can also dictate your slide content. Press and hold fn to dictate your market summary directly into your text box.

faq.question: Can I use Lazur to format my slides automatically?
faq.answer: Lazur does not click buttons or edit your files. It guides you to the right tools so you can perform the actions yourself, keeping you in control of your design.

faq.question: Why is my PowerPoint on Mac running slowly?
faq.answer: Large files with high resolution images or complex embedded data often cause performance issues. Try compressing your images or splitting your presentation into smaller files.

faq.question: What is the best way to handle linked data from Excel?
faq.answer: Paste your Excel data using Edit > Paste Special and choose Paste Link. This ensures that when you update the Excel file, your PowerPoint chart updates automatically.
